summary: Read two columns of integers that are already sorted in ascending order, with lengths m and n. The two columns are never empty at the same time. Combine every integer into one ascending whole and find its middle value. When the count is odd, write the central value. When the count is even, write the arithmetic mean of the two central values as a decimal. Keep the amount of comparison work within a logarithmic scale of m plus n.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
